The receipt carries a constant diagnostic plus a physically-resolved, home-elided run-dir path (root/separator-only homes rejected as needles), so no process output, credential shape, or packet-derived text can reach a committed artifact; the preserved directory stays mode 0700 under TMPDIR.

The change is additive and local to one wrapper, reverting restores prior behavior with no migration or persisted state, and the two new receipt keys are relayed without interpretation per the gate contract; the register rows land in the same change as the package they describe.
